title: A record opened from a drill counts only the drawn rows: 「共 N 条」 and previous / next ignore the drill's total
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found while fixing PR #36461 (card #36256, a dashboard or page-block drill opens a filtered list) on 2026-11-22, and measured there by its dev. Filed by the seat, not claimed. Parent: #36256.

## What happens

Open a drill, then open a record from its list. The record page's counter, 「第 1 条，共 N 条」, counts only the rows drawn on screen, not the drill's total, and the previous / next steps stop at the last drawn row. Measured: a drill whose read reports a total of 40 drew 2 rows, and the record page received those 2 rows as its siblings.

## Why

In `plugin-list`, `ListViewBlock` spreads the host's props and then sets `onTotalChange={reportTabCount}` after them, so a host's own `onTotalChange` (the drill's) is overwritten and never called. The drill then has no total to hand to `openRecord`.

## To do

1. Let a host's `onTotalChange` reach the list: call both (the host's and `reportTabCount`), or let the host's win where it is given.
2. Hand the drill's total and its condition to the record page, so 「共 N 条」 and previous / next walk the drill's whole result, paging as needed.
3. Pin it: a drill whose read reports 40 rows opens a record that reads 「第 1 条，共 40 条」; a list outside a drill keeps its tab count.

## Done when

A record opened from a drill shows the drill's total and can step through every record of the drill, not only the rows drawn.

Blocked-by: #36461

## Grade
p2 · area:ux · domain:ui (same reach as #36256).
